Name: Hexafruit - Over Powered Crop
Author: SharkTeethy
Description:
[size=2]I've been informed that hexagons are the bestagons, so why don't we apply that?[/size]

[size=5]STATS
[/size]
[size=3]Hexafruit seeds can be bought at Sandy's shop for 10g, and sell at normal quality for 1050g. It takes 15 days in any season for the plant to fruit and must be harvested with a scythe. It will not regrow. 

Hexafruit salad can be made with three starfruit, one melon, one grape, and one hexafruit. The recipe unlocks at level nine. By request, it sells for only 1500g, significantly less than all its parts combined.
[/size]
[size=3]Hexafruit give 125 energy and 56 health, hexafruit salad gives 250 energy and 112 health.

[/size]The plant is purple, inspired by the many real life plants that are that color, but if you want to imagine its magic or something go ahead.
